description: Code, stored Monte Carlo histogram sufficient statistics, robustness checks, and figures accompanying the article. Raw walker trajectories and unbinned reaction times are not retained; full deterministic simulation scripts and seed metadata are included.

title: Reproduction package for Prescribing finite-window reaction-time modes with a static fixed-budget Doi reactivity field
